title.zh: 提高证券交易委员会现行收费并授权其就某些服务收取费用的法案
title.en: An Act to Increase the Fees Now Charged By the Securities and Exchange Commission and to Authorize It to Collect and Receive Fees for Certain Services
title.orig: An Act to Increase the Fees Now Charged By the Securities and Exchange Commission and to Authorize It to Collect and Receive Fees for Certain Services

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_944_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: All laws or parts of any law, in conflict with, or contrary to, the provisions of his Act, are hereby repealed: Provided, That existing laws, orders and regulations authorizing the Securities and Exchange Commission to collect and receive fees for services not mentioned herein shall remain in full force and effect.

This Act shall take effect after fifteen days from the date of its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1953.
